title: Harness Runtimes
name: Name
makeDefault: Use as default for new chats
inheritedWorkspace: Uses the working directory selected in PandaForce.
connectionHint: Select a runtime first, then configure its model and connection.
accountHint: Accounts are supplied by the administrator through the selected connection profile.
handoffHint: Switch after this turn finishes. Only selected context is sent; files stay in the workspace.
switched: Harness changed. Your conversation history is preserved.
uncertain: The connection ended before execution was confirmed. Review the saved reply before continuing.
summaryHint: Keep confirmed goals, constraints and decisions here. These notes are scoped to this conversation.
defaultHint: Changing the default does not switch existing conversations.
empty: No runtime is available. Ask an administrator to check its connection.
legacyHint: The visible recent conversation will be carried over. Earlier records remain in the original session.
errorInvalidInput: Check the runtime settings and try again.
errorNotFound: This conversation or runtime is unavailable.
errorForbidden: You do not have access to this runtime or workspace.
errorConflict: Settings changed. Refresh and try again.
errorBusy: Finish or stop the current turn, then try again.
waitToSend: Send after this reply, or stop it now. Your draft will stay here.
errorUnavailable: Could not connect to this runtime. Your draft is preserved.
errorAuthentication: Sign in to this runtime account and check the connection again.
errorCapabilityUnavailable: This runtime does not support the requested action or attachment.
errorWorkspaceUnavailable: The selected working directory is unavailable to this runtime.
errorContextTooLarge: The selected context is too large. Reduce the included material and try again.
errorDeliveryUncertain: Execution could not be confirmed. Review the saved conversation before continuing.
errorLeaseLost: Execution ownership changed. Refresh to see its current status.
errorInvalidProtocol: The runtime returned an unsupported protocol response.
errorTimeout: The runtime did not respond in time. Check its status before sending again.
errorHistoryCorrupt: The conversation history could not be verified. The original files have been preserved.
pingHint: Sends “hi” through the model in a temporary session. Uses model quota; nothing is added to your chats.
permissionAskDescription: Ask in this conversation when a tool action needs approval. Existing runtime allow and deny rules still apply.
permissionAlwaysDescription: Run tool actions without asking in this conversation. Runtime deny rules and hooks still apply; filesystem isolation stays as configured.
permissionUnavailable: Permission settings are unavailable for this runtime.
permissionNextTurn: Changes apply to the next message. The current run keeps its original permissions.
selectionHint: Choose a runtime first, then its model and reasoning level. Applies to the next message or task.
selectionUnavailable: The saved selection is unavailable. It is preserved until you change it.
selectionError: This runtime, model or reasoning level is unavailable. Check your selection and retry.
mediaHint: Image and video generation use the configured media renderers.
